correctness.rationale: The exact factor b_n=n/gcd(n,A_{n-1}) gives nu2(b_n)=max(0,nu2(n)-nu2(A_{n-1})). With K even, internal dyadic-block indices have odd b_n; at powers of two valuation increases by exactly t=nu2(K+2) when previous V_r=r, hence b_n=2 and the claimed ceiling staircase. With K odd, all odd indices >=3 produce even multipliers; for even n>=6 their accumulated factors force nu2(A_{n-1})>=nu2(n), making b_n odd. Direct n=4 modulo12 computation gives {1,3,11}; all n>=5 multipliers are even, proving lower bound. Induction covers all n, not just tested n.
